sections.text: Approved vendors may receive Dataset Y provided they hold a current Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and have completed annual security certification.
Vendor X is prohibited from receiving Dataset Y under any circumstances. This restriction may not be waived.
The Analytics department may not share Dataset Y with any external vendor without express written approval from the Chief Data Officer.
Dataset Z may be shared with any Tier 1 Approved Vendor without additional approval.
Exception requests for Dataset Y sharing may be submitted to the Data Governance Committee. Requests must include business justification, risk assessment, and DPA confirmation.

A waiver for Dataset Y sharing may be granted by the Data Governance Committee provided: (1) the requesting department submits a formal exception request using Form DGC-EXC-01; (2) the vendor has no outstanding compliance violations; (3) the Chief Data Officer approves in writing. Waivers are valid for 12 months and must be renewed annually.
